additional_info.subject: ID0476998-DC/Si-D/SE- [RVP/T8170005125] Faulty Connector CRM:03276000078
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0476998
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-
SE
SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
RVP/T8 170005125
Charger ID / Serial No.:
ftZHwT
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason:
Following the client’s report and after our internal checks, it is necessary to replace the Wago plug XD, as I suspect it is the cause of the issue.
As an alternative approach to help identify the root cause during our on-site intervention, we can perform the following actions:
Swap TF1 and TF2 to determine whether the issue remains on Outlet 2 or moves to Outlet 1.
Connect TF2 directly to the PLC analog input board to verify whether the problem is related to the wiring.
In parallel, we also need to carry out several charging sessions with the Volvo Trucks to assess the charger’s performance.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-SE SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Felipe Moraes

additional_info.subject: ID0476998-DC/Si-D/SE- [RVP/T8170005125] Faulty Connector CRM:03431000053
additional_info.body:
Dear Magnus,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support, I hope this email finds you well.
Since the last email was with the wrong steps I could check the information again with our experts and this is the correct way to fix the situation.
Following the client’s report and after our internal checks, it is necessary to replace the TF1, We can perform the following actions:
Transducer has life sign fault, possible solutions:
1. Check if transducer power supply 24V is ok
2. Check by swapping the voltage transducer TF2 with TF1
3. If needed replace the voltage transducer.
8EM5903-0AA01-0AA5 | -TF1, -TF2, -TF5 | Voltage Transducer 1500VDC / 10VDC
Apart from this information, should I send the ticket to the RC-SE or may I proceed with closing this ticket?
With best r
egards,
eMobility Technical Support Team – Felipe Moraes
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
